name: oil painting
definition: pigment bound in a drying oil, on canvas, panel or a similar support.
notes: Oil filter on Singulart; Artsy Oil Painting; Motokawa oil painting.

name: acrylic painting
definition: pigment bound in acrylic polymer emulsion.
notes: Acrylic filter on Singulart; Motokawa acrylic painting.

name: watercolour
definition: transparent pigment in gum arabic, applied wet, normally on paper.
notes: Watercolor filter and Motokawa watercolor listed as painting medium.

name: gouache
definition: opaque, chalk-bodied water-based colour, normally on paper.
notes: Gouache filter on Singulart; Motokawa gouache.

name: ink wash painting
definition: black or coloured ink brushed in graded washes on paper or silk, in the East Asian manner.
notes: Artsy East Asian Ink-and-Wash Painting; Motokawa sumi-sai (ink wash with colour).

name: mineral-pigment painting (nihonga)
definition: ground mineral pigments fixed with animal glue on paper or silk (kind status provisional under CV-27 until a seller outside Japan lists it apart).
notes: Nihonga listed only by a Japanese seller; CV-27 outside-Japan seller not yet found.

name: tempera painting
definition: pigment bound in egg yolk or another egg or glue medium, usually on a prepared panel.
notes: Tempera is a Singulart technique filter and an Artsy medium.

name: encaustic painting
definition: pigment in hot beeswax, fused to a support.
notes: Encaustic (beeswax and damar resin) on cradled wood panel sold as painting.

name: fresco (detached or transferred)
definition: pigment applied to wet or dry lime plaster, now removed from its wall.
notes: Spanish 16th century fresco fragment mounted on wood, sold as a wall decoration painting.

name: mixed-media painting
definition: a painting in which several paint media or added materials are used together and the image is painted, not built from pasted elements.
notes: Artsy Mixed-Media; Motokawa mixed media listed beside oil and watercolor.

name: spray-paint painting
definition: an image made mainly with aerosol or spray paint on canvas, panel or another support.
notes: Spray Paint is a Singulart Top technique; Artsy Spray Paint.

name: portrait miniature
definition: a small painted portrait made as a work of its own, often on vellum, ivory, card or metal (provisional until a page sells it as its own category, F-13).
notes: Portrait miniatures on ivory sold as paintings; Artsy lists Miniature and Small-Scale Paintings.

name: animation cel
definition: an image hand-painted in acrylic on a transparent acetate sheet, made for an animated film (provisional until a page sells it as such, F2-O2).
notes: 42 animation cels for sale incl. hand-painted and Japanese production cels.

name: graphite (pencil) drawing
definition: an image drawn with graphite pencils.
notes: 1,922 graphite drawings for sale on 1stDibs.

name: charcoal drawing
definition: an image drawn with charcoal.
notes: Drawings > Charcoal category, realistic charcoal drawings for sale.

name: pastel drawing
definition: an image drawn with pigment sticks (soft pastel, oil pastel) on paper or a similar ground.
notes: Pastel drawings for sale on 1stDibs.

name: coloured-pencil drawing
definition: an image drawn with pigmented pencils.
notes: 519 colored pencil drawings for sale on 1stDibs.

name: pen-and-ink drawing
definition: an image drawn with pen, nib or marker in ink.
notes: 464 pen and ink drawings for sale on 1stDibs.

name: woodcut
definition: an image cut with knives and gouges into the side grain of a wood block and printed from the raised surface.
notes: Woodcut named in Sothebys guide; Artsy Woodcut and Linocut.

name: linocut
definition: an image cut into a linoleum sheet and printed from the raised surface.
notes: Linocut defined as relief technique with linoleum sheet.

name: wood engraving
definition: an image cut with gravers into the end grain of a hardwood block.
notes: Wood engraving sold by Gerrish Fine Art; glossary defines it as relief on hard wood.

name: etching
definition: lines bitten into a coated metal plate with acid.
notes: Etching named in guide and Artsy Etching/Engraving.

name: line engraving
definition: lines cut into a metal plate with a burin.
notes: Engraving into polished metal plate; Singulart Engraving print filter.

name: drypoint
definition: lines scratched directly into a plate with a needle, without acid.
notes: Drypoint defined as cut directly into metal plate with sharp point.

name: mezzotint
definition: a plate roughened all over with a rocker, then burnished from dark to light.
notes: Mezzotint: plate uniformly pitted with a rocker.

name: aquatint
definition: tone made by acid biting through a porous ground of resin dust.
notes: Aquatint creates printed tonal areas.

name: stone lithograph
definition: an image drawn with a greasy medium on limestone and printed from the stone.
notes: Lithography listed; pages do not say stone, so stone vs offset is unshown.

name: offset lithograph
definition: an image transferred from a plate through a rubber blanket to paper.
notes: Calder poster listed as vintage offset print and lithograph; glossary: offset lithography.

name: screenprint
definition: ink pushed through a mesh stencil, one stencil per colour.
notes: Ink pushed through mesh screen; Singulart Screen Printing filter.

name: monotype
definition: a single unique impression pulled from a painted or inked blank surface.
notes: Monotype is the only print method giving a unique example.

name: monoprint
definition: a unique impression from a reusable matrix, varied by inking or additions each time.
notes: Artsy medium Monotype/Monoprint; glossary has no separate monoprint entry.

name: collagraph
definition: a print from a plate built up by gluing materials onto a board.
notes: 152 collagraph prints for sale on 1stDibs.

name: inkjet print
definition: an image sprayed from a print head with pigment or dye inks onto paper, canvas or another sheet; the printer system is the attribute `printing_system`.
notes: Giclee print filter on Singulart; glossary: giclee is the French term for inkjet.

name: gelatin silver print
definition: silver halide in a gelatin layer on paper, exposed and developed in a darkroom.
notes: Gelatin silver print named as dominant 20th century process.

name: daguerreotype
definition: an image on a silvered copper plate.
notes: Daguerreotype: sharp images on silver-plated copper, announced 1839.

name: chromogenic print
definition: colour dyes formed in the layers of colour paper by development.
notes: Chromogenic prints use cyan, magenta and yellow layers.

name: dye-transfer print
definition: colour made by transferring dyes from matrices onto paper.
notes: Dye-transfer prints named in guide; no dye-transfer listing fetched.

name: silver dye bleach print
definition: colour dyes already in the paper, bleached away where not wanted.
notes: Ilfochrome photograph for sale; page does not use term silver dye bleach.

name: archival pigment print
definition: a pigment inkjet print of a photograph on fine-art paper.
notes: Archival pigment prints are inkjet with long-life ink.

name: platinum or palladium print
definition: an image in platinum or palladium metal on paper.
notes: Platinum print on gold leaf sold; palladium not shown on page.

name: cyanotype
definition: an iron-salt print giving a blue image.
notes: Handmade cyanotype triptych for sale on 1stDibs.

name: tintype
definition: a positive image on a thin iron plate.
notes: Antique tintype category on 1stDibs with tintype photographs for sale.

name: photogram
definition: an image made without a camera by placing objects on light-sensitive material.
notes: Photogram works listed for sale on 1stDibs.

name: instant print
definition: a self-developing print from an instant camera or film pack.
notes: 278 Polaroid photographs for sale on 1stDibs.

name: bronze sculpture
definition: cast copper-tin alloy, usually patinated.
notes: Bronze is a Singulart sculpture medium; bronze masks and torsos on Artsper.

name: steel and iron sculpture
definition: steel, iron or other ferrous metal welded, forged, cut or bent to form.
notes: Steel, stainless steel and cast iron are Singulart sculpture media.

name: pewter and other cast-metal figurine
definition: an ornamental figure cast in pewter, zinc, tin or another non-bronze metal.
notes: Royal Selangor pewter collectible figurines sold by W Hamond; tin 92-97 percent.

name: stone carving
definition: marble, limestone, alabaster or other stone carved to form.
notes: Stone and marble are Singulart sculpture media.

name: jade carving
definition: a figure or object carved from jade.
notes: Carved jade figures for sale on 1stDibs.

name: wood carving
definition: a figure or sculpture carved from wood.
notes: Hand-carved wood figurative sculptures for sale; Wood is a Singulart medium.

name: ivory and bone carving
definition: a figure or sculpture carved from ivory, bone, horn or antler.
notes: Meiji ivory okimono carvings for sale; Bone is a Singulart medium.

name: terracotta sculpture
definition: modelled or moulded clay fired without a glaze.
notes: Terracotta is a Singulart sculpture medium.

name: glazed earthenware and stoneware sculpture and figurine
definition: a figure or sculpture in glazed fired clay other than porcelain.
notes: 585 glazed ceramic, stoneware and terracotta figurative sculptures for sale.

name: porcelain and bone china figurine and sculpture
definition: a figure or sculpture in porcelain or bone china.
notes: Lladro and Royal Doulton porcelain figurines for sale on 1stDibs.

name: glass and crystal sculpture and figurine
definition: a blown, cast, fused or cut glass or lead-crystal figure or sculpture.
notes: Glass figurative sculptures and Swarovski crystal figurines for sale.

name: resin sculpture and figurine
definition: a cast resin figure or sculpture, usually painted.
notes: Resin is a Singulart sculpture medium; resin figurine shop page not fetched.

name: plaster sculpture
definition: cast or modelled plaster.
notes: Plaster is a Singulart sculpture medium.

name: wax sculpture
definition: modelled or cast wax.
notes: Wax Sculpture for Sale category on Artsper.

name: soft sculpture
definition: a three-dimensional sculpture of fabric, fibre or other soft material, stuffed, wrapped or stitched.
notes: Artsy Soft Sculpture; Textile is a Singulart sculpture medium.

name: found-object assemblage
definition: a sculpture assembled from found, salvaged or discarded objects, or from several materials none of which governs.
notes: Assemblage Sculpture for Sale: Arman, Spoerri, Pras; Reclaimed objects medium.

name: neon sculpture
definition: a sculpture in which a lit gas-discharge tube or an equivalent light source is the medium.
notes: Neon Tube Light is a Singulart sculpture medium.

name: tapestry
definition: a picture or pattern woven on a loom to hang on a wall.
notes: 4,607 woven tapestries for sale on 1stDibs.

name: embroidered picture
definition: a picture worked in thread with a needle on a fabric ground.
notes: Framed needlepoint and embroidery pictures for sale; Artsy Embroidery.

name: brush and pen calligraphy
definition: writing made as the picture, in brush or pen script.
notes: Calligraphy art listings: Chinese ink, Japanese, Arabic; Artsy East Asian Calligraphy.

name: seal carving [篆刻]
definition: script characters carved into a seal of stone or another material as a work of art, sold as the seal or its impressions (provisional until a fetched seller sells it apart from calligraphy).
notes: Hand-carved Shoushan stone seal sold as collectible; sold as the seal.

name: collage
definition: a picture built from pasted or bonded elements (paper, cloth, photographs, found flat material).
notes: Collage is a Singulart painting technique and an Artsy medium.

name: mosaic picture
definition: a picture set in small pieces (tesserae) of stone, glass or ceramic.
notes: Sicis handmade glass mosaic wall piece for sale; Artsy Mosaics.

name: sculpture plinth or stand
definition: a base, plinth or stand made for one sculpture (provisional until a page attests it).
notes: Stands, plinths and pedestals sold for displaying sculpture on 1stDibs.
